title: APS-200 Common Object Contract
_status: DRAFT TOP-LEVEL STRUCTURAL CONTRACT — semantic/profile closure remains governed by APS text and open decision records.
description: Draft machine-readable contract for the common APS-200 object envelope required on every entity. Concrete entity schemas are responsible for closing unknown top-level fields explicitly.

object_id.description: Canonical identifier. Exact syntax remains bound to the applicable entity/profile contract.

schema_version.description: Representation/schema contract version for the entity.

integrity_hash.description: Lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the canonical object, excluding the integrity_hash member itself.
